status: Open decomposition. All 13 directly owned Connector/BindingConnector constraints are listed; this does not close inherited Feature/Type obligations or all connector requirements.

constraints.name: checkConnectorBinarySpecialization
constraints.requirement: A binary Connector must directly or indirectly specialize the base Connector Links::binaryLinks from the Kernel Semantic Library.
acceptancePartitions: Exactly two connector ends versus fewer/more; exact Links::binaryLinks identity; missing or ambiguous library base; direct and inherited specialization.

constraints.name: deriveConnectorSourceFeature
constraints.requirement: The sourceFeature of a Connector is its first relatedFeature (if any).
sourceExpressions: sourceFeature = if relatedFeature->isEmpty() then null else relatedFeature->first() endif
acceptancePartitions: Empty, singleton and multiple complete related features; first identity and order; incomplete endpoint evidence is not null.

constraints.name: checkConnectorTypeFeaturing
constraints.requirement: Each relatedFeature of a Connector must have each featuringType of the Connector as a direct or indirect featuringType (where a Feature with no featuringType is treated as if the Classifier Base::Anything was its featuringType).
sourceExpressions: relatedFeature->forAll(f |      if featuringType->isEmpty() then f.isFeaturedWithin(null)     else featuringType->forAll(t | f.isFeaturedWithin(t))     endif)
acceptancePartitions: Empty connector featuring types and Base::Anything convention; one/multiple featuring types; every related feature; chained endpoints and incomplete isFeaturedWithin evidence.

constraints.name: deriveConnectorTargetFeature
constraints.requirement: The targetFeatures of a Connector are the relatedFeatures other than the sourceFeature.
sourceExpressions: targetFeature =     if relatedFeature->size() < 2 then OrderedSet{}     else          relatedFeature->             subSequence(2, relatedFeature->size())->             asOrderedSet()     endif
acceptancePartitions: Zero/one/two/many related features; exclude first position, preserve remaining ordered-set identities; repeated endpoint identities.

constraints.name: checkConnectorObjectSpecialization
constraints.requirement: A Connector for an AssociationStructure must directly or indirectly specialize the base Connector Objects::linkObjects from the Kernel Semantic Library.
acceptancePartitions: Association versus AssociationStructure typing, including inherited/intersection typing; exact Objects::linkObjects base; unavailable association evidence.

constraints.name: validateConnectorBinarySpecialization
constraints.requirement: If a Connector has more than two connectorEnds, then it must not specialize, directly or indirectly, the Association BinaryLink from the Kernel Semantic Library.
acceptancePartitions: More than two connector ends with and without Links::BinaryLink specialization; incomplete negative specialization evidence; review connectorEnds spelling in the pinned expression.

constraints.name: deriveConnectorRelatedFeature
constraints.requirement: The relatedFeatures of a Connector are the referenced Features of its connectorEnds.
acceptancePartitions: Ordered effective connector ends, including inherited/redefined ends; absent/one/malformed ReferenceSubsetting; exact target sequence with duplicates retained; invalid ownership; current edits.

constraints.name: checkConnectorSpecialization
constraints.requirement: A Connector must directly or indirectly specialize the base Connector Links::links from the Kernel Semantic Library.
acceptancePartitions: Exact Links::links identity through direct or indirect paths; absent library, malformed paths, cycles and metadata-sensitive changes.

constraints.name: validateConnectorRelatedFeatures
constraints.requirement: If a Connector is concrete (not abstract), then it must have at least two relatedFeatures.
acceptancePartitions: Concrete versus abstract; zero/one/two/many related features; end count distinct from related-feature count; incomplete derivation cannot justify validity.

constraints.name: deriveConnectorDefaultFeaturingType
constraints.requirement: The defaultFeaturingType of a Connector is the innermost common direct or indirect featuringType of the relatedFeatures of the Connector, so that each relatedElement is featured within the defaultFeaturingType, if such exists.
sourceExpressions: let commonFeaturingTypes : OrderedSet(Type) =      relatedFeature->closure(featuringType)->select(t |          relatedFeature->forAll(f | f.isFeaturedWithin(t))     ) in let nearestCommonFeaturingTypes : OrderedSet(Type) =     commonFeaturingTypes->reject(t1 |          commonFeaturingTypes->exists(t2 |              t2 <> t1 and t2->closure(featuringType)->contains(t1)     )) in if nearestCommonFeaturingTypes->isEmpty() then null else nearestCommonFeaturingTypes->first() endif
acceptancePartitions: No common featuring type, one, nested and incomparable candidates; exact first nearest candidate in source order; cycles and incomplete featuring closure; source edits.

constraints.name: checkConnectorBinaryObjectSpecialization
constraints.requirement: A binary Connector for an AssociationStructure  must directly or indirectly specialize the base Connector Objects::binaryLinkObjects from the Kernel Semantic Library.
acceptancePartitions: Cross-product of binary end count and AssociationStructure association; exact Objects::binaryLinkObjects base; unknown antecedents cannot prove inapplicability.

constraints.name: validateBindingConnectorIsBinary
acceptancePartitions: Exactly two related-feature sequence positions versus zero/one/many; preserve repeated target identities (x=x); distinguish related-feature count from stored-end count.

constraints.name: checkBindingConnectorSpecialization
constraints.requirement: A BindingConnector must directly or indirectly specialize the base BindingConnector Links::selfLinks from the Kernel Semantic Library.
acceptancePartitions: Exact Links::selfLinks path; inherited base closure; missing, wrong or stale library identity.

crossingAndChainingDependencies.name: deriveFeatureCrossFeature
sourceExpressions: crossFeature =     if ownedCrossSubsetting = null then null     else          let chainingFeatures: Sequence(Feature) =              ownedCrossSubsetting.crossedFeature.chainingFeature in         if chainingFeatures->size() < 2 then null         else chainingFeatures->at(2)     endif

crossingAndChainingDependencies.name: deriveFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting
sourceExpressions: ownedCrossSubsetting =     let crossSubsettings: Sequence(CrossSubsetting) =          ownedSubsetting->selectByKind(CrossSubsetting) in     if crossSubsettings->isEmpty() then null     else crossSubsettings->first()     endif

crossingAndChainingDependencies.name: validateFeatureCrossFeatureSpecialization
sourceExpressions: crossFeature <> null implies     ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature.crossFeature->             forAll(f | f <> null implies crossFeature.specializes(f))

crossingAndChainingDependencies.name: checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureTypeFeaturing
sourceExpressions: isOwnedCrossFeature() implies     let otherEnds : OrderedSet(Feature) =          owner.oclAsType(Feature).owningType.endFeature->excluding(self) in     if (otherEnds->size() = 1) then         featuringType = otherEnds->first().type     else         featuringType->size() = 1 and         featuringType->first().isCartesianProduct() and         featuringType->first().asCartesianProduct() = otherEnds.type and         featuringType->first().allSupertypes()->includesAll(             owner.oclAsType(Feature).ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature->                select(crossFeature() <> null).crossFeature().featuringType)           endif

crossingAndChainingDependencies.name: validateCrossSubsettingCrossedFeature
sourceExpressions: crossingFeature.isEnd and crossingFeature.owningType <> null implies     let endFeatures: Sequence(Feature) = crossingFeature.owningType.endFeature in     let chainingFeatures: Sequence(Feature) = crossedFeature.chainingFeature in     chainingFeatures->size() = 2 and     endFeatures->size() = 2 implies          chainingFeatures->at(1) = endFeatures->excluding(crossingFeature)->at(1)

implementationBoundary: owned_results::binary_binding_targets reads one exact two-end construction recipe. It does not implement the effective connectorEnd/relatedFeature derivations, featuring closure, library-specialization obligations or complete validation. Public relatedFeature/defaultFeaturingType presently return Approximate in the explicit default-binding diagnostic.
constructionDecision: Qualify a named namespace-owned chain and its enclosing bindings first. Inline endpoint chains are owned cross features and bring separate crossing-specialization, typing, featuring and redefinition obligations; substituting the expression result identity alone does not preserve contextual meaning.
remainingDependencies: Exact effective connector ends and their inheritance/redefinition order.
ReferenceSubsetting property/inverse ownership and complete Feature type/featuring operations.
Association and AssociationStructure effective typing and library specialization.
Ordered Expression/result chaining and its isFeaturedWithin validation.
Applicability of initial FeatureValues and startShot contexts.
Per-effective-feature versus per-valuation default construction; no change is assumed justified by a successful raw endpoint read.
next: Implement the checked end/related-feature dependency boundary with explicit incomplete results, separate from constructor provenance.
Use these acceptance partitions for public positive/negative and deliberate raw-graph cases; preserve declared normative ambiguities instead of normalizing them silently.
Complete inherited obligations and a second review before any connector-family closure.

relatedFeature.finding: Preserve repeated endpoint identities. A binding x=x has two relatedFeature positions and must not be deduplicated before binary validation.

connectorEnd.finding: Use the complete effective endFeature domain, including inheritance/redefinition, not only two stored end memberships.

association.finding: Association typing must come from the complete checked Feature.type provider.

targetFeature.finding: Drop the first related-feature position, then preserve first occurrence order in the remaining ordered set.

compatibilityBoundary: derived.rs::d_related_feature_positions preserves raw end positions for compatibility projections. A fully checked sourceFeature must instead use the first element of the derived relatedFeature sequence, even when an earlier complete end has no ReferenceSubsetting. Keep per-end display positions separate from this normative projection.

constructionReview.status: Baseline physical graph diagnostic passed; missing paths and incomplete checked domains reproduced. Semantic implementation remains open.
findings: The materialized diagnostic confirms absent Links::links/selfLinks paths for the tested plain Connector, authored BindingConnectors and eleven generated reference/default bindings.

Generated binding factory stages its own endpoints but no unconditional connector-base specialization. Adding a base alone may expose inherited end features unless its end positional redefinitions are qualified in the same construction.
Complete Association/AssociationStructure and Connector feature projections are outside the current supported-root boundary; do not certify complete connectorEnd from a raw stored-end count.

results.authoredPlainConnectorAndBindings: c, b and same have no inspected path to Links::links, Links::binaryLinks or Links::selfLinks.
results.explicitSpecializationControl: declared subsets Links::selfLinks has all three paths; checked connectorEnd remains Approximate and checked type reports AmbiguousSpecialization. Cause of that type result is not yet isolated.

generatedBindings.finding: All eleven lack the three inspected specialization paths.

results.repeatedEndpoint: same retains two endpoint positions with the same identity.

diagnostic.limits: The path walk inspects owned and projected implied specialization relationships. Absence is bounded to that graph, not a complete negative semantic proof. One fixture does not cover all connector or generated-binding families.

coupledConstructionAcceptance: Confirm materialized unconditional Links::links and Links::selfLinks paths for authored and every generated binding family.
Qualify complete Association/AssociationStructure feature/end domains and exact ordered end positional targets; do not add a base while leaving duplicate inherited ends visible.
Plan base relationships and required end redefinitions against one immutable source, admit all generated identities before append, then validate that final effective ends match the planning evidence.
Missing/ambiguous library identities, partial library inheritance, malformed inverse claims and exhausted work must not publish a partial coupled family.

Exercise source edits, warm queries, raw/prepared/serialized libraries, collision refusal, retries and interaction with existing reference-result, constructor, invocation-default and accept receiver factories.

projectionAcceptanceExamples.meaning: Repeated identities are two sequence positions, so x=x remains a binary binding.
Remove the first position only; target uniqueness preserves first occurrence order and may include the source identity.
A complete absent ReferenceSubsetting contributes no related position; the normative source is the first resulting related feature, independently of display end slots.
This individual rule passes its sequence-size condition, but broader binary-specialization/end constraints can still reject the model. Do not collapse these obligations.
